title: Juicy Grilled Irish Lamb Skewers
description: A satvik-friendly Irish dish featuring lamb skewers marinated in a shio-koji cure and grilled to perfection with Braeburn apples on a robata grill, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes and apple pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
